summary: Adds a new test that appends a selected series with samples at t=500 and t=chunkRange, runs CompactSelectedSeries, and checks both samples are still queryable. It guards against losing a sample on the chunk-range boundary, and it changes no production code, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: New test: CompactSelectedSeries keeps sample on chunk-range boundary
reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior; it adds coverage and removes no assertions.
